ASHISH S. DUBEY Mumbai, Maharashtra | +91- 8149386877| Dubeashish1@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/ashish-dubey123

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of enterprise delivery experience specializing in Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and Supply Chain. Delivered full-cycle CLM implementations across Agiloft and Legadox platforms for 7+ enterprise clients — Croma, Tata Capital, Sun Pharma, SBI General, Mastek, Sterling & Wilson, and SPARC — and architected a P2P Procurement Portal achieving a 30% boost in operational efficiency. Expert in translating stakeholder complexity into precision BRDs, FRDs, and User Stories; orchestrating zero-defect UAT cycles; and driving Agile delivery using Jira, Confluence, and Zoho Projects.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis & Requirements Engineering: BRD, FSD, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, RTM, Use Case Development, Requirements Gathering & Elicitation, Stakeholder Analysis Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Purchase Requisition (PR), Purchase Order (PO), GRN, Invoice Governance, Three-Way Matching, Procurement Workflow Automation Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM): Agiloft CLM, Legadox Platform, Contract Drafting & Negotiation, Obligation Tracking, Renewal Automation, Compliance Monitoring, Vendor Contract Governance, DocuSign Integration Business Process Optimization: AS-IS/TO-BE Analysis, Gap Analysis, Business Process Reengineering, Process Mapping, Workflow Optimization, BPMN Governance & Approval Frameworks: Approval Matrix Design, Delegation of Authority (DoA), Workflow Routing, Governance Controls, Regulatory Compliance Agile Delivery & SDLC: Scrum, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Agile Delivery, Waterfall & Hybrid SDLC Testing, Release & Implementation: UAT Strategy, Test Planning, Defect Management, Risk Mitigation, Release Readiness, Go- Live Support Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Vendor Lifecycle Management, SRM, SLA Governance, Cross-Functional Alignment, JAD Sessions, Requirements Workshops Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Zoho Projects, Visio, Lucid chart, Advanced Excel, SQL, Data Visualization, MS Office Suite, Agiloft CLM, DocuSign, Logic Gate Risk Cloud (TPRM), Deloitte Omnia

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst – AWS Aditi Consulting (Amazon), Mumbai

Apr 2026 – Present

▪ AWS Stakeholder Management: Engaged with cross-functional AWS product and engineering stakeholders to gather,

analyze, and prioritize business requirements; facilitated JAD sessions and requirement workshops ensuring end-to-end alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.

▪ Business Requirements & Documentation: Authored detailed BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria for AWS

operational workflows; maintained full traceability through RTM and managed requirements lifecycle across Agile sprints in JIRA and Confluence.

▪ Data Analysis & Visualization: Conducted end-to-end process analysis of AWS operational datasets; created dashboards and

visualization reports to monitor key performance indicators, service metrics, and engagement efficiency — providing actionable insights to leadership for data-driven decision-making.

▪ Automation of Data Analysis: Identified manual data processing bottlenecks and collaborated with engineering teams to define requirements for automating data analysis workflows — reducing manual effort, minimizing errors, and improving turnaround time for reporting cycles.

▪ Conducted AS-IS/TO-BE process mapping and gap analysis for AWS internal operational workflows; defined TO-BE state

requirements and contributed to business process reengineering initiatives improving operational efficiency.

▪ Coordinated UAT cycles for AWS process solutions — developed test scenarios, managed cross-functional stakeholder

validation, triaged defects, and confirmed production readiness for smooth go-lives.

Business Analyst – Procurement & Supply Chain Yashuss Unlimited Business Solutions, Mumbai

Jun 2025 – Mar 2026

▪ Stakeholder Workshops & Requirements: Spearheaded cross-functional workshops with procurement, finance, and

operations teams to elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, ensuring end-to-end stakeholder alignment.

▪ Documentation & Traceability: Authored BRD, FSD/FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and maintained RTM to bridge

business needs with system configurations; managed full requirements lifecycle through Agile sprints.

▪ P2P Lifecycle Engineering: Engineered end-to-end PR → PO → GRN → Invoice Validation → Three-Way Matching → Multi-

Level Approval Routing → Budget Controls pipeline with full procurement workflow automation.

▪ Conducted AS-IS/TO-BE process analysis and gap analysis to identify inefficiencies and drive business process reengineering

— directly contributing to 30% operational efficiency improvement.

▪ Designed multi-level Approval Matrix (DoA) frameworks and defined business validation rules, exception handling logic, and

vendor onboarding protocols for robust vendor lifecycle management.

▪ Configured SLA monitoring dashboards, shipment tracking tools, and supply chain visibility metrics to improve operational

coordination and executive decision-making velocity.

▪ Orchestrated UAT cycles: developed test scenarios, managed cross-functional validation, triaged defects, mitigated risks, and

confirmed production readiness for zero-downtime go-lives.

▪ Authored SOPs, user manuals, and training materials; led KT sessions facilitating smooth change management, high user

adoption, and long-term operational continuity.

Business Analyst – CLM & Supply Chain Prosares Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai

Dec 2021 – May 2025

▪ CLM Delivery – 7+ Enterprise Clients: Delivered full-cycle CLM implementations across Agiloft and Legadox platforms for Croma, Tata Capital, Sun Pharma, SBI General, Mastek, Sterling & Wilson, and SPARC — driving digital transformation in legal, procurement, and compliance functions. Configured Agiloft workflows, clause libraries, templates, permissions, and reports; managed end-to-end setup, customisation, and implementation including DocuSign integration for e-signature automation.

▪ Conducted deep-dive requirements elicitation with legal, procurement, and compliance stakeholders; translated complex

contractual needs into functional specifications and system configuration requirements.

▪ Contract Lifecycle Workflows: Designed contract drafting, clause library management, multi-level approval routing, automated renewal triggers, amendment tracking, termination processes, and end-to-end obligation management; integrated DocuSign for seamless e-signature workflows within the contract lifecycle. Implemented approval governance frameworks with regulatory compliance checks, risk mitigation controls, and full audit traceability — supporting internal and external regulatory audits.

▪

▪ Agiloft CLM Administration & Support: Administered and customised Agiloft CLM — configuring workflows, approval templates, clause libraries, user permissions, and reporting dashboards; provided ongoing user support, system troubleshooting, and platform enhancements to drive adoption and operational continuity.

▪ Risk & Audit Tool Administration: Supported administration and configuration of Logic Gate Risk Cloud (TPRM) for third-

party risk management workflows; worked with Deloitte Omnia audit tool to facilitate audit documentation, control testing coordination, and compliance evidence management.

▪ Collaborated with engineering teams to configure contract metadata structures, document management controls, workflow

routing logic, and CLM platform integration touchpoints.

▪ Led UAT programmes across all 7+ deployments — developed test scenarios, managed stakeholder validation, triaged

defects, confirmed production readiness; zero critical post-go-live defects across the portfolio.

▪ Maintained comprehensive documentation suite (functional specs, release notes, configuration guides, user manuals)

enabling seamless knowledge transfer and sustained operational continuity.

Test Engineer Foray Software Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore

Aug 2021 – Oct 2021

▪ Developed and executed functional test cases and regression test suites aligned with business requirements and functional

specifications, ensuring high software quality and QA standards adherence.

▪ Participated in Agile sprint cycles supporting defect triage, bug tracking, defect management, and validation processes in

close collaboration with development and QA teams.

Associate Software Engineer Hexaware Technologies Ltd., Navi Mumbai

Apr 2019 – Jun 2021

▪ Airline Domain Testing – Air Canada: Executed functional and regression testing for the ticket booking module — validating

fare calculations, availability checks, passenger reservation workflows, and booking processes against business requirements.

▪ Reviewed requirement documents, functional specifications, and user stories to identify validation gaps prior to release,

contributing to reduced post-production defects.

▪ Collaborated with BA, Dev, and QA teams in Agile environment for defect triage, root cause analysis, retesting, and

verification — maintaining high QA standards throughout the SDLC.

Web Support Engineer Kush Infosystem Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai

Apr 2018 – Apr 2019

▪ Provided first-line technical and functional support for enterprise web applications, troubleshooting functionality,

performance, user access, and browser compatibility issues.

▪ Assisted in requirements clarification, user feedback analysis, and documentation updates (knowledge base, FAQs,

checklists) — reducing repeat incidents through improved self-service resources.

▪ Collaborated with Dev, QA, and client teams to reproduce defects, verify fixes in staging, and support post-release

monitoring to facilitate smooth deployments.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

▪ P2P Portal – Full-Cycle Ownership: Spearheaded end-to-end Procure-to-Pay portal implementation integrating PR, RFQ, PO, GRN, invoice governance, three-way matching, multi-level approval frameworks, and workflow automation — delivering 30% operational efficiency gain and enterprise-wide procurement visibility.

▪ CLM at Scale – 7+ Marquee Clients: Led Legadox and Agiloft CLM deployments for Croma, Tata Capital, Sun Pharma, SBI General, Mastek, Sterling & Wilson, and SPARC — designing governance, obligation management, auto-renewal triggers, amendment tracking, DocuSign e-signature integration, and audit-compliant workflows. Zero critical post-go-live defects across the entire portfolio.

▪ UAT Programme Leadership: Designed and led UAT strategy across multiple enterprise P2P and CLM programmes — developing test scenarios, coordinating stakeholder validation, managing defects, and confirming release readiness — achieving successful go-lives with minimal post-production issues and high user adoption.

▪ Organisational Recognition: Recognised for precision-grade documentation (BRD, FSD, RTM, SOPs, configuration guides),

structured JAD facilitation, and governance-driven system design — enabling seamless business-IT alignment and knowledge continuity across Agile delivery environments.

EDUCATION

University of Mumbai, Mumbai, Maharashtra Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (B.Sc. IT)

2017
